verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe direct agent read/write access to a user's real files, Drive/Dropbox imports, and MCP integrations, but nowhere mention a sandbox, staging, or test environment isolated from production data. Community comments even highlight anxiety about the agent having broad access to real files with no isolation layer. missing for 10: any documented sandbox/staging mode, test data set, or isolated environment separate from the user's live files.
